product_intent.summary: The planner exports repository-native planning artifacts from a canonical graph.
target_users: Coding agents consuming scoped execution context
goals: Keep execution slices traceable to requirements and decisions
mvp_scope: Export PRD, RFC, architecture, dependency, and Work Item projections
non_goals: Live provider calls during deterministic export
constraints: Core logic remains independent from filesystem and CLI adapters
success_criteria: Export output can be reviewed before implementation handoff

requirements.title: Export projections
requirements.statement: The planner must export deterministic repository planning projections.

decisions.title: Use canonical graph as source
decisions.selected_option: Use the Planning Graph as the source of truth.
decisions.rationale: A canonical graph keeps generated artifacts deterministic and reviewable.
rejected_alternatives: Treat Markdown projections as canonical state

components.title: Planning graph core
components.responsibility: Represent planning nodes, dependency edges, validation, readiness, and projection inputs.

interfaces.name: Domain API
interfaces.contract: Pure functions transform typed graph inputs without filesystem or process access.

work_items.title: Wire projection export
work_items.context_summary: Connect projection rendering to the export use case through application ports.
boundary_notes: Do not add live provider calls.
Keep filesystem writes behind adapter ports.
work_items.safe_failure_guidance: Stop and report any unsafe projection path or missing graph metadata.

edges.rationale: Export uses the canonical graph decision.
Work occurs in the core/API boundary.
